show.description: Elite ex-soldier Ranveer becomes the personal bodyguard of biotech CEO Sanjana after a deadly attack targets her revolutionary formula, “Divine.” As assassins, corporate rivals, and the ruthless Oberoi empire close in, Ranveer risks everything to protect her. Amid violent conspiracies and growing romance, a shocking truth emerges, Ranveer’s mission is also personal, tied to his parents’ murder and the secret behind Divine.
